t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Try to find the colour pattern in the first round and it will yield more mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: It seems random; you then think a pattern emerges but it is not always consistent but try to stick with it; e.g. x1 small number match with the wizard with the small hat, x 5 match with the higher hat but then colours may also play a part in it! Try to work out as best you can a pattern as it does seem to give more mushrooms and ignore it when it seems to give you less mushrooms on some occasions.
